verdict.rationale: First-party documentation clearly covers Linux for this card. The product page lists Linux x86 64-bit OS support, ROCm 7.2.1 names Radeon 9000 Series on Linux, the PyTorch and JAX install pages list the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) by name, and the Radeon/Ryzen installer bundles the amdgpu driver. However, the only independent coverage in the pack is TechPowerUp's gaming review, which says nothing about Linux, so the independent-testing half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on Linux testing of the RX 9070 XT, and documented Linux driver release notes or changelogs specific to this part.
